snippet.title: Solipsistic | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam for free: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4819820/Solipsistic/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer_launch

Join our discord to stay up to date: https://discord.gg/w6KQpbthCB
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theblackfilesgame
X: https://x.com/BlackFilesGame

Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

You wake up inside a program, controlling a person with no memories who begs for your help. While restoring his Memory fragments through file manipulation outside of the game, it's revealed that another person interrupts the process, claiming the program is a seal. 

Someone is lying. And you have the power to make the right choice.
